skill.name: triage
skill.description: Guide maintainers through issue triage, state labels, agent briefs, and out-of-scope records for engineering workflows.
skill.summary: Triage engineering issues into clear states and prepare durable handoff notes for agents or humans.

content.value_statement: Engineering issue queues often mix bugs, feature requests, and incomplete reports. This skill guides maintainers through triage states, reporter follow-up, and agent-ready handoff notes.
actual_capabilities: Lists unlabeled, needs-triage, and needs-info issues in attention order.
Reviews issue bodies, comments, labels, reporter activity, and prior triage notes.
Recommends bug or enhancement categories with a single workflow state.
Prepares agent briefs with behavior, interfaces, acceptance criteria, and scope boundaries.
Records rejected enhancements in an out-of-scope knowledge base.
Adds a required AI-generated disclaimer to triage comments.
limitations: Requires access to the project issue tracker and the correct label mapping.
Does not make product decisions without maintainer direction.
Depends on accurate issue reports and available project context.
Does not implement code changes; it routes and documents issues.

use_cases.title: Sort Incoming Issues
use_cases.description: Review new and stale issues, then assign the right category and state before work starts.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent Work
use_cases.description: Turn a well understood bug or enhancement into an agent brief with clear acceptance criteria.

use_cases.title: Track Rejected Requests
use_cases.description: Document repeated out-of-scope feature requests so future triage can reuse prior decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Show Issues Needing Attention
prompt_templates.prompt: Use triage to show unlabeled, needs-triage, and needs-info issues. Summarize each issue in one line and wait for my choice.

prompt_templates.title: Triage One Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Use triage on issue #42. Read the issue, comments, labels, and prior triage notes. Recommend a category and state with reasoning.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Agent Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Ready work for an autonomous agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Use triage to move issue #42 toward ready-for-agent. Confirm the change, then draft a durable agent brief with acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a Repeated Rejection
prompt_templates.prompt: Use triage for issue #87. Check out-of-scope records for similar requests, summarize the prior decision, and recommend whether to close or reconsider.

output_examples.input: Show me anything that needs my attention.
output_examples.output: The skill returns three buckets: unlabeled issues, needs-triage issues, and needs-info issues with new reporter activity.
The skill confirms the role change, asks whether to write an agent brief, and prepares a structured handoff when approved.
The skill checks out-of-scope records, surfaces similar rejected requests, and asks the maintainer to confirm the next action.

best_practices: Confirm the project label mapping before applying any role changes.
Read previous triage notes and out-of-scope records before recommending a state.
Include the required AI-generated disclaimer on every triage comment.
anti_patterns: Applying conflicting state roles without asking the maintainer first.
Posting vague needs-info comments that do not ask specific questions.
Writing agent briefs with brittle file paths or line numbers.

faq.question: What issue trackers does this skill support?
faq.answer: It is written for project issue trackers and GitHub-style labels. It needs the actual label mapping for your repository.

faq.question: Can it close issues automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide closing a wontfix issue after maintainer confirmation. The workflow expects maintainer approval before action.

faq.question: Does it write implementation plans?
faq.answer: It writes agent briefs for ready work. These briefs describe behavior, interfaces, acceptance criteria, and scope.

faq.question: How does it handle incomplete bug reports?
faq.answer: It gathers context, attempts reproduction when appropriate, and drafts specific questions for the reporter.

faq.question: What is the out-of-scope knowledge base?
faq.answer: It is a set of Markdown records for rejected enhancement requests and the reasoning behind those decisions.

faq.question: Does it replace maintainer judgment?
faq.answer: No. It recommends categories and states, then waits for maintainer direction before applying important changes.
